data.title: Search reaches the agent from the first init
data.description: Owner's call 2026-09-29, after a review of the prompt hook: init installs both Claude Code hooks by default, creating .claude/settings.json when there is none, says so, and --no-hooks opts out. The hook stays unconditional on coverage - measured: a 0.7 coverage gate silences 72/75 answerable questions while still speaking on 5/30 code prompts - but its wording turns conditional and a record already shown in a session is not shown again (state in os.tmpdir(), keyed by session_id, never in .kadence/ - I6). Then: measure what the hook costs on 10 read-only code tasks with and without it (20 agents), and one live claude -p run in a scratch copy to see the output reach the agent.
